table.retrieve:
SELECT
	Manufacturer = M.Name,
	SaleInvCode = S.SaleInvCode,
	Date = S.Date,
	AliasName = A.AliasName,
	itemcategory=(select name from itemcategory where itemcategory.icatcode=I.icatcode),
	icatcode=I.icatcode,
	CustomerName = A.Name,
	ItemAliasName = I.CustomICode,
	ItemName = I.Name,
	Qty = SD.LooseQty,
	Bonus = SD.BonusQty,
	SalePrice = SD.SalePrice,
	GrossValue = Round(SD.LooseQty * SD.SalePrice, 2), 
	DiscPerc = SD.DiscPerc,
	DiscValue = ROUND(SD.LooseQty * SD.SalePrice * SD.DiscPerc * 0.01, 2),
	SaleValue = Round(SD.LooseQty * SD.SalePrice * (1 - SD.DiscPerc * 0.01), 2),
	ClaimAbleDiscPerc = SD.DiscPerc - CASE WHEN :d_unclaimeddiscperc > SD.DiscPerc THEN SD.DiscPerc ELSE :d_unclaimeddiscperc END,
	ClaimValue = ROUND(SD.LooseQty * SD.SalePrice * (SD.DiscPerc - CASE WHEN :d_unclaimeddiscperc > SD.DiscPerc THEN SD.DiscPerc ELSE :d_unclaimeddiscperc END) * 0.01, 2)
FROM
	SaleLedger S,
	SaleDetail SD,
	Accounts A,
	Item I,
	Manufacturer M
WHERE
	S.Date BETWEEN :ad_startdate AND :ad_enddate AND
	S.Posted = 'Y' AND
	S.SaleInvCode = SD.SaleInvCode AND
	S.CustCode = A.AccCode AND
	SD.DiscPerc BETWEEN :d_startdiscperc AND :d_enddiscperc AND
	SD.ICode = I.ICode AND
	I.ManfCode = M.ManfCode AND
	M.ManfCode IN (:ai_manfcode)
ORDER BY
	Manufacturer,
	SaleInvCode,
	Date,
	CustomerName,
	I.Name
table.sort: manufacturer A, saleinvcode A, date A, customername A, itemname A
